{{Quote|Take your last breaths, Rebel scum! Fire at will!|Lieutenant Commander Jilan Noor leads the bridge crew of Freighter M226 in defending the bridge from a Rebel strike force|<ref name="PH" />}}
At some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out a '''hijacking''' of [[Freighter M226]], one of the [[Temple-class heavy freighter|freighters]] of the secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] known as the [[Perlemian Haul]].<ref name="PH" />
